{{Top}}
{{Quote|Ahh... Disruptors, finally. Disintegrates durasteel, wood, flesh, just about anything really.|[[Tyber Zann]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Alliance_disruptor_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistol]].]]

A '''disruptor''' was a particularly powerful type of energy weapon often preferred by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Disruptor weapons were similar to their blasters counterparts in many ways, such as the use of [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] and [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]]. Popular forms of this weapon included the [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistol]] and the [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifle]]. Disruptors were illegal on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and in many places merely possessing one would earn an instant [[Death/Legends|death]] sentence. Even under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], only a select few [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Imperial officer (disambiguation)|Officers]] were permitted to utilize them. Examples included the [[Class-D detonator]], [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] [[GSI-21D]], [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[Model MSD-32 Disruptor Pistol]] and the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] [[DX-2 disruptor pistol/Legends|DX-2]] and [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle|DXR-6]].

==Disruptor mechanics==
{{Quote|Remember&mdash;no disintegrations.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
[[File:DXR-6_disruptor_rifle.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A DXR-6 disruptor rifle.]]

On a basic level, a disruptor worked by using large quantities of blaster gas, such as [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas, many times more than a standard blaster. The energy beam fired by a disruptor was generated in almost the same manner as the particle beam fired by a blaster, though the beam used much more blaster gas. A disruptor's internal components were quite different than that of a blaster's, though. The blaster gas used to generate the beam underwent a considerably different transformation that formed the disruptor beam. The resultant blast was short-ranged, unstable, less cohesive, and extraordinarily powerful. Disruptor beams generated by these weapons differed from that of a standard blaster. They created an energy wave consisting of disruptive, nonharmonic energy pulses that excited a target's molecules to the point that it destroyed the bonds that held their constituent atoms together, painfully. In simpler terms, disruptor weapons used extremely high amounts of unstable blaster energy, enough to obliterate matter on a higher scale than normal blasters. A shot from a disruptor rifle could do this in less than a full [[Standard second|second]], vaporizing a being almost instantly. A disruptor was capable of disintegrating a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] target, turning it to a pile of ash, and was quite effective against other solid targets, even capable of damaging [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hulls, though the massive amount of blaster gas used by disruptors made them inefficient and impractical for starship use.

As a drawback, in addition to being illegal and short-ranged, other than the Tenloss [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle]], disruptors generally only had enough ammunition for a few shots, and were incapable of firing rapidly or being set to [[Stun/Legends|stun]]. However, some [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistols]] were capable of being set to overload, a setting which greatly increased the pistol's power for a single shot. Unfortunately this usually resulted in the firearm being rendered useless, due to the weapon's internals suffering damage from focusing even more energy into what was already an unstable form of tibanna gas particles.

[[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] like [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used disruptors on assassination missions.
